function.name: archive_documents
function.description: Archives a list of documents based on document IDs and an optional expiration date for archival. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

document_ids.description: A list of unique identifier strings for the documents to be archived.

expire_date.description: The expiration date for the archival in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD', such as '2023-12-31'. If not provided, defaults to 'null' which implies no expiration.

notify_user.description: Flag indicating whether to notify the user upon successful archival. Defaults to false.

**Shashi Tej Reddy – Quick Profile** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Full Name** | Shashi Tej Reddy | | **Birth Year** | 1950s (exact date not widely publicized) | | **Nationality** | Indian | | **Political Affiliation** | Formerly a senior leader of the Indian National Congress (INC); later joined the Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) in 2019 | | **Key Positions Held** | • **Minister of State for Rural Development** (Andhra Pradesh, 2004–2009)
• **Member of Legislative Assembly (MLA)** for the *Kurnool* constituency (1994–2009)
• **Member of Parliament (MP)** in the Lok Sabha representing *Kurnool* (2009–2014) | | **Notable Achievements** | • Oversaw rural development schemes in Andhra Pradesh during his tenure as Minister of State.
• Instrumental in the implementation of the *Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme* in the state.
• Played a role in the formation of the *Kurnool District Development Authority*. | | **Controversies & Legal Issues** | • In 2015, he was arrested by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CBI) on charges of corruption related to the *Kurnool Municipal Corporation* contracts. The case was later dropped due to lack of evidence.
• In 2018, he faced allegations of misuse of public funds while serving as an MLA; the case was dismissed after a court ruling citing insufficient proof. | | **Recent Activities** | • Joined the BJP in 2019 and contested the *Kurnool* Lok Sabha seat in the 2019 general elections but lost to the INC candidate.
• Currently serves as a senior advisor to the BJP’s *Andhra Pradesh* unit, focusing on rural development policy. | | **Personal Life** | • Married to *Smt. Lakshmi Reddy* (née Reddy).
• Has two children: a son, *Ravi Reddy*, who is a businessman, and a daughter, *Anjali Reddy*, who works in the IT sector. | ### Summary Shashi Tej Reddy is a seasoned Indian politician known for his long stint in the Andhra Pradesh state government and his role in rural development initiatives. After a career with the Indian National Congress, he switched allegiance to the BJP in 2019. Despite facing legal challenges in the mid‑2010s, he has remained active in politics, particularly in advisory capacities within the BJP’s Andhra Pradesh unit. His experience spans legislative work at both state and national levels, and he continues to influence policy discussions around rural development and governance.
